Mission 1: National Park Quest

Obstacle: Storm Cloud. Timer challenge is active. Clear it by listening carefully and answering the questions.

Mission Brief

  • Understand a trip dialogue.
  • Identify specific information.
  • Recognize simple past verbs.
Reward: Park Explorer badge + unlock Island 2

Listen and follow the text

Show transcript
Galang: Hi, Monita. I went to Lestari National Park last Saturday. Monita: Really? What did you do there? Galang: First, I visited the orchid house. Then, I took some photos of rare plants. After that, I walked with my group and observed herbal plants. Monita: Did you see the black orchid? Galang: Yes, I did. It was beautiful. Monita: Wow. Did you enjoy the trip? Galang: Of course. It was fun and educational.
Task 1. Where did Galang go?
Task 2. What did Galang do there?
Task 3. Which group contains only past verbs from the dialogue?

Mission 2: Recount Builder

Obstacle: Broken Bridge. Timer challenge is active. Rebuild it by understanding recount structure and event order.

Mission Brief

  • Find orientation, events, and reorientation.
  • Understand sequencing words.
  • Build the correct order of a recount.
Reward: Recount Builder badge + unlock Island 3

Quick reminder

Orientation = who, where, when Events = what happened first, next, then, after that Reorientation = feeling or closing comment
Task 1. Which sentence is the orientation?
Task 2. Which sentence is the reorientation?
Task 3. Which order is correct?

Mission 3: Underwater Adventure

Obstacle: Coral Gate. Timer challenge is active. Unlock it by mastering while/when and the model recount.

Mission Brief

  • Listen to the model recount.
  • Use while + past continuous + simple past.
  • Identify the closing comment.
Reward: Grammar Diver badge + unlock Final Island

Model recount audio

Show transcript
Last month, I went to Karimun Jawa with other students from different schools. We stayed there for two days. On the first day, we enjoyed the sunset and took many photos. The next day, we went snorkeling and saw colorful fish. While I was swimming near the boat, I saw a sea turtle. I felt excited because it was my first time seeing one so closely. It was a short trip, but it was one of the most memorable experiences in my life.
Task 1. Complete the sentence: While I was swimming near the boat, I ... a sea turtle.
Task 2. Which pattern is correct?
Task 3. Which sentence is the closing comment?
